A powerbank that snaps into place
The magnetic back locks onto any compatible phone case, so there's no cable to fumble for between meetings. Pull it off, top up, snap it back on.
Sized for a pocket, not a drawer
At 6.3 x 1.4 x 9.3 cm it slides into a jacket pocket or laptop sleeve without adding bulk — built to actually get carried, not left on a desk.
Branding that survives daily handling
UV print sits on the front face and holds up to the pocket-and-bag routine far better than a sticker or engraving. Our team confirms placement with a free digital mockup first.
Enough charge for a real top-up
20W USB-C PD gets a phone from empty to comfortable fast, and the 7.5W magnetic wireless mode covers a quick boost without hunting for a cable.

The hard PU cover keeps corners sharp even after months in a bag, so it still looks new at the next onboarding session or sprint planning.

Your logo goes on via foil stamp or deboss directly into the cover, which reads as considerably more premium than a printed label and won't peel.
